name: Amazon
description: The world's largest online store. Search and sort the catalog, read product, offer, delivery, and review details, explore product rankings by category, and add or remove cart items. For the signed-in account, search purchase history, browse regular, open, and digital orders, track packages, and view buy-again suggestions, wishlists, Subscribe & Save subscriptions, and Prime membership.

actions.label: Sign in to Amazon
actions.description: Amazon sign-in URL.

actions.label: Check provider sign-in
actions.description: Checks whether you are signed in to Amazon.

actions.label: Search products
actions.description: Searches Amazon products. You can narrow results to a department and sort by price, reviews, newest arrivals, or best sellers.

actions.label: List departments
actions.description: Lists the Amazon departments available for narrowing a product search.

actions.label: Get product
actions.description: Product page facts — title, brand, price, rating, breadcrumbs, and feature bullets — by ASIN or product URL.

actions.label: Get offer
actions.description: Buy box seller and fulfillment facts — sold by, ships from, and whether Amazon sells or fulfills it.

actions.label: List reviews
actions.description: Lists customer reviews and the rating summary for a product.

actions.label: Search orders
actions.description: Searches your complete Amazon purchase history for products matching a phrase and returns each match with its order number and purchase date.

query.description: A product name or phrase to find in past orders.

actions.label: List orders
actions.description: Lists your orders with order numbers, dates, totals, delivery status, and items. You can browse regular, open, or digital orders and limit regular orders by time period.

orderFilter.description: Choose regular order history, orders that are still open, or digital orders.

actions.label: Get order details
actions.description: Full detail for one order — placed date, ship-to address, payment method, charge breakdown (subtotal, discounts, tax, grand total), line items with unit price / seller / return window / Subscribe & Save cadence, shipment statuses with tracking URLs, and the invoice URL.

input.description: Order id like 114-1234567-1234567, or an order-details URL

actions.label: Track package
actions.description: Shows a shipment's current status, tracking number, carrier, and event history. Choose a shipment from an order or order details.

actions.label: Get cart
actions.description: Lists current cart items across the main Amazon, Fresh, and Amazon Now carts. Main-cart items include the line id needed to remove one, title, price, selection, stock, and delivery details.

actions.label: Remove cart item
actions.description: Removes one item from the main Amazon cart using the line id returned by the cart. This changes the cart but does not place an order.

itemId.description: The main-cart line id returned by the cart action.

actions.label: Add to cart
actions.description: Adds a retail or local-store product to the matching cart. An offer returned by product search can select the exact seller and cart; otherwise Amazon's current offer is resolved from the product.

actions.label: Review checkout
actions.description: Reviews an in-progress local-store checkout, including the subtotal, fees, tax, tip, total, and delivery window. Nothing is purchased.

actions.label: Set delivery tip
actions.description: Sets the driver tip in U.S. dollars for an in-progress local-store checkout. This does not place the order.

actions.label: Place order
actions.description: Places the in-progress local-store order. This spends real money and is final, so review the checkout first.

actions.label: List buy-again items
actions.description: Lists products you buy repeatedly, along with their current prices.

actions.label: List wishlists
actions.description: Lists your wish lists with their names and links, ready for opening or browsing.

actions.label: List wishlist items
actions.description: Lists the products on a wish list, including title, price, byline, and when each was added.

list.description: Wishlist id or URL from listWishlists

actions.label: List Subscribe & Save subscriptions
actions.description: The user's active Subscribe & Save subscription cards from the Manage Your Deliveries page. Empty when the account has no active subscriptions.

actions.label: Get Prime membership
actions.description: The user's Prime membership facts — plan, price, billing period, renewal date, and last payment date.

actions.label: List ranking categories
actions.description: Lists the categories available for a Best Sellers, New Releases, or Movers & Shakers ranking. Use a returned category URL to browse that category's ranked products.

actions.label: List rankings
actions.description: Lists ranked products from Amazon Best Sellers, New Releases, or Movers & Shakers, optionally within a category.

zh-Hans.name: 亚马逊
zh-Hans.description: 综合网上商城。搜索商品并排序，查看商品、报价、配送和评论，按类别浏览排行榜，以及添加或移除购物车商品。登录后还可搜索购买记录，查看普通订单、未完成订单、数字订单、包裹、再次购买建议、心愿单、定期购和 Prime 会员信息。

getSignInState.label: 检查亚马逊登录状态
getSignInState.description: 检查你是否已登录亚马逊。

searchProducts.label: 搜索商品
searchProducts.description: 搜索亚马逊商品。可按部门缩小范围，并按价格、评价、新品或畅销程度排序。

listDepartments.label: 部门列表
listDepartments.description: 列出可用于缩小商品搜索范围的亚马逊部门。

getProduct.label: 获取商品
getProduct.description: 按 ASIN 或商品网址返回商品页信息——标题、品牌、价格、评分、面包屑及功能要点。

getOffer.label: 获取报价
getOffer.description: 返回购买框的卖家与配送信息——售出方、发货方，以及是否由亚马逊销售或配送。

listReviews.label: 评论列表
listReviews.description: 列出某件商品的买家评论和评分汇总。

searchOrders.label: 搜索订单
searchOrders.description: 在完整的亚马逊购买记录中搜索与关键词匹配的商品，并返回对应的订单号和购买日期。

listOrders.label: 订单列表
listOrders.description: 列出你的订单，包括订单号、日期、总额、配送状态和商品。可查看普通订单、未完成订单或数字订单，并按时间筛选普通订单。

getOrderDetails.label: 获取订单详情
getOrderDetails.description: 单个订单的完整详情——下单日期、收货地址、支付方式、费用明细（小计、折扣、税费、总计）、含单价/卖家/退货期限/定期购周期的商品明细、含追踪网址的发货状态，以及发票网址。

trackPackage.label: 追踪包裹
trackPackage.description: 显示单次发货的当前状态、追踪号、承运商和物流记录。请从订单或订单详情中选择发货信息。

getCart.label: 获取购物车
getCart.description: 列出亚马逊主购物车、Fresh 和 Amazon Now 购物车中的当前商品。主购物车商品还包含可用于移除商品的行编号、标题、价格、选中状态、库存和配送信息。

deleteCartItem.label: 移除购物车商品
deleteCartItem.description: 使用购物车返回的行编号，从亚马逊主购物车移除一件商品。此操作会更改购物车，但不会下单。

addToCart.label: 加入购物车
addToCart.description: 将零售或本地商店商品加入对应的购物车。可使用商品搜索返回的报价来指定卖家和购物车，否则会采用亚马逊当前提供的报价。

getCheckout.label: 查看结账信息
getCheckout.description: 查看本地商店结账中的小计、费用、税费、小费、总额和配送时间。不会购买任何商品。

setTip.label: 设置配送小费
setTip.description: 为进行中的本地商店结账设置美元小费。不会提交订单。

placeOrder.label: 提交订单
placeOrder.description: 提交进行中的本地商店订单。此操作会实际扣款且不可撤销，请先核对结账信息。

listBuyAgain.label: 再次购买列表
listBuyAgain.description: 列出你经常购买的商品及其当前价格。

listWishlists.label: 心愿单列表
listWishlists.description: 列出你的心愿单及其名称和链接，可继续打开或浏览。

listWishlistItems.label: 心愿单商品
listWishlistItems.description: 列出某个心愿单中的商品，包括标题、价格、副标题和加入时间。

listSubscriptions.label: 定期购订阅列表
listSubscriptions.description: 来自"管理你的配送"页的用户有效定期购订阅卡片。账户无有效订阅时为空。

getPrimeMembership.label: 获取 Prime 会员
getPrimeMembership.description: 用户的 Prime 会员信息——套餐、价格、计费周期、续费日期及上次付款日期。

listRankingCategories.label: 排行榜类别
listRankingCategories.description: 列出畅销榜、新品榜或飙升榜可用的类别。可使用返回的类别网址浏览该类别的排名商品。

listRankings.label: 排行榜列表
listRankings.description: 列出亚马逊畅销榜、新品榜或飙升榜中的商品，也可限定到某个类别。
